wikidot5e:spell:cure-wounds.effectSummary: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. The spell has no effect on undead or constructs. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d8 healing.

wikidot5e:spell:dancing-lights.effectSummary: Create up to four torch-sized lights in range, appearing as torches, lanterns, glowing orbs, or combined into one vaguely humanoid Medium form. Each light sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius. As a bonus action, move the lights up to 60 feet to new positions within range. Each light must remain within 20 feet of another light created by the spell and disappears if it moves beyond the spell's range.

wikidot5e:spell:danse-macabre.effectSummary: Animate up to five visible Small or Medium corpses as zombies or skeletons of your choice. Each gains a bonus to its attack and damage rolls equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. As a bonus action, mentally command all creatures made by this spell that are within 60 feet, issuing the same order to each; without commands they only defend themselves, and an order persists until complete. They remain under your control until the spell ends, then become inanimate. Each slot level above 5th animates up to two additional corpses.

wikidot5e:spell:dark-star.effectSummary: Create a sphere centered within range with a radius up to 40 feet. Its area is magical darkness and difficult terrain: darkvision cannot see through it and nonmagical light cannot illuminate it. No sound can be created within or pass through the sphere; creatures entirely inside are deafened, creatures and objects entirely inside are immune to thunder damage, and spells with verbal components cannot be cast there. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 8d10 force damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP by this damage is disintegrated, along with worn and carried nonmagical items, into fine gray dust.

wikidot5e:spell:darkness.effectSummary: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot-radius sphere around a point in range, spreads around corners, cannot be seen through with darkvision, and cannot be illuminated by nonmagical light. If the point is on an object you hold or an unattended object, the darkness moves with it; completely covering that source with an opaque object blocks the darkness. Where this darkness overlaps light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the light spell is dispelled.

wikidot5e:spell:dawn.effectSummary: Create a 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of bright sunlight centered at a point in range. When it appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking 4d10 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. A creature repeats this save whenever it ends its turn in the cylinder. If you are within 60 feet of the cylinder, you can use a bonus action to move it up to 60 feet.

wikidot5e:spell:daylight.effectSummary: A point in range emits bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for another 60 feet. If placed on an object you hold or an unattended object, the light moves with it; completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. Where this light overlaps darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the darkness spell is dispelled.

wikidot5e:spell:death-ward.effectSummary: Protect a touched creature for 8 hours. The first time damage would reduce it to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead and the spell ends. If, while the spell remains, an effect would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target and the spell ends.

wikidot5e:spell:delayed-blast-fireball.effectSummary: Create a glowing bead at a point in range. When the spell ends, the bead explodes around corners in a 20-foot-radius sphere; creatures there make Dexterity saves, taking the accumulated fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Base damage is 12d6 and increases by 1d6 at the end of each of your turns while the bead remains undetonated. A creature touching the bead before detonation makes a Dexterity save: on a failure it detonates immediately; on a success the creature can throw it up to 40 feet, and it detonates when it strikes a creature or solid object. The blast damages objects and ignites unattended flammable objects. Each slot level above 7th adds 1d6 to the base damage.

wikidot5e:spell:demiplane.effectSummary: Create a shadowy door on a visible flat solid surface. The door is large enough for Medium creatures and opens into an empty 30-foot-by-30-foot-by-30-foot demiplane of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the doors on both sides disappear, trapping anything still inside. Each casting can create a new demiplane or reconnect to one you previously created. If you know the nature and contents of a demiplane created by another casting of this spell, you can connect to that demiplane instead.
